headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 3, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing an 8-0 victory. Wenceel Pérez led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. The San Diego Padres dropped a 2-3 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies, unable to overcome a strong performance from the Phillies' pitching staff. Gavin Sheets led the Padres at the plate with a home run and two RBIs. The Baltimore Orioles secured a 4-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Shane Baz earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. The Boston Red Sox have placed third baseman Nick Sogard on the 10-day injured list due to a right oblique strain, effective retroactive to May 31, 2026. The Tampa Bay Rays have placed right-handed pitcher Jonathan Heasley on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026. The Houston Astros have placed shortstop Braden Shewmake on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026, and transferred shortstop Carlos Correa from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. The Athletics have transferred right-handed pitcher Brooks Kriske from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. The San Diego Padres have placed left fielder Ramón Laureano on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 31, 2026, and transferred right-handed pitcher Nick Pivetta from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list. The Colorado Rockies have transferred left-handed pitcher Welinton Herrera from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list.

The Minnesota Twins have acquired right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates, who received cash in return. The Detroit Tigers have traded right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies have traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash.
